item.text: Both stores currently keep one global array, and the Zustand member view reads those arrays directly. I’m checking the app and package copies so the fix follows the repository’s sync pattern.
The app and `drive-store` package have matching copies of this code. I’ll add share keyed store actions and getters, then make the member view select data only for its resolved share.

The stores and view now use share IDs for reads and writes, including invitations created after a share is first added. I’ll add regression tests for two shares, replacement, removal, permission updates, and the email utility.

item.text:
Fixed the Drive member view so it reads members, internal invitations, and external invitations for the current share only. The stores now key those lists by `shareId`, and their updates leave other shares’ data intact. I also added [getExistingEmails](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_views/utils/getExistingEmails.ts) and regression tests for share isolation.

Verified with the new tests in both Drive copies, existing share tests, TypeScript checks for both projects, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.
